causal_reconstruction.bar_clock: Completed UTC-aligned 5-minute states are reconstructed from messages grouped by local_timestamp; last_price supplies OHLC and (mark_price-index_price)/index_price supplies the causal premium close.
causal_reconstruction.confirmation: One or two complete post-settlement bars [T,T+5m) or [T,T+10m).
causal_reconstruction.entry: First observed last_price at or after T+(confirm_bars+1)*5m, required within 1 second of that boundary.
causal_reconstruction.exit: First observed last_price at or after entry+15/30/60/120 minutes, required within 1 second.
causal_reconstruction.global_slot: One accepted position across all eligible symbols; same-entry conflicts use frozen state score then symbol order; entry at or before the preceding exit timestamp is prohibited.
causal_reconstruction.pre_state: Pre-close and premium use [T-5m,T). The signed 60-minute move uses the close 12 completed bars earlier. sigma5 is the square-root mean of the prior rolling 48 five-minute squared log returns with at least 36 observations.
causal_reconstruction.settled_rate_availability: For a funding_timestamp T, the final funding_rate becomes usable at the first record carrying T whose local_timestamp is >= T and <= T+5 minutes.
causal_reconstruction.settlement_filter: Only nonzero settlements inside the source UTC day with sufficient prior state are admitted. The 00:00 event is skipped because first-day files do not contain the required prior 60-minute and volatility state.

data_contract.provider: Tardis public normalized Bybit derivative_ticker first-day samples

source_coverage_eligibility.rule: Eligibility is determined only from source availability and causal field completeness, never returns or candidate performance.

fit_only_thresholds.funding_and_premium_quantiles: estimated per eligible symbol from unique fit settlements only

interpretation_boundary.if_survivor: Keep 2024 sealed and reconstruct remaining pre-2024 continuous data, exact BBO/depth, first-imbalance-retracement execution, actual hold-period funding, structural exits, risk sizing and continuous NAV.
interpretation_boundary.if_zero_survivors: Retire this exact first-day Tardis funding-transfer formulation. Reopen only with continuous point-in-time coverage or a materially different cash-transfer/payoff source, not adjacent threshold tuning.

prohibitions: No 2024-2026 file URL, request, row or outcome.
No exchange timestamp in place of local arrival time for information availability.
No same-boundary or favorable OHLC fill.
No symbol inclusion based on return or candidate performance.
No family, threshold, cost, baseline, gate or fallback change after fit/development outcome rows are read.
No cumulative-ranking promotion from this sparse proxy screen.

sparse_matched_baseline.source: fit events only; evaluated separately by confirmation-bars and horizon
